basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality NutriSole UI extending the exact existing visual language in the three attached reference PNGs. These are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Preserve warm ivory paper #faf8f1, forest green #123f2c, near-black #080d16, muted grey #5c626d, hairline #ebe7df, softly rounded cream grouped surfaces, original calm spacing, green primary buttons, thin outline icons, understated natural texture. Use Roboto-like sans for controls and Libre Caslon-like elegant serif for brand/large welcome headings. Match the references' character, density and component shapes, avoid redesign. Two fonts maximum. Body at 14–16 logical px, labels crisp and readable.
Target: a SINGLE complete mobile APP CONTENT screen, logical 393 x 852 px, high-resolution portrait at the same proportion. Use 24 px side margins, generous vertical spacing, 18–22 px logical card radii and 52–56 px primary button. Fill the entire image with the app surface. NO phone hardware, device bezel, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar/clock/signal/battery, home indicator, browser frame, external annotations or collage. Do not include reference phone bodies. No shadows around whole screen. No clipped text. One primary task/action with only the necessary supporting content. Do not add marketing hero graphics, extra metrics or unrelated features.
Current date anchor: Wednesday 30 September 2026, containing week Monday Sep 28 – Sunday Oct 4. Use those correct date/day pairs for any NEW week/history data, while existing original screens are unchanged. These are FRONTEND CONCEPTS with synthetic demo fixtures. Do not invent live/verified market data, real health records, diagnostic claims, medications/doses, clinical thresholds or backend access. Where needed mark sample data. Informational support only, keep missing information visibly unavailable, not zero.
Produce the new screen described below. Use precise legible text and match the references' design system.
